description: Send a new email now, from the user's mailbox to everyone in "to", "cc" and "bcc"; a copy is saved to Sent Items. This tool cannot recall it after sending. To save it without sending, use create_draft; to let the user review and edit it first, use compose_email. "to", "cc", and "bcc" accept a string or an array of strings. Prefer arrays for multiple recipients (e.g. ["alice@example.com"]).

to.description: Recipient email address(es). Use an array: ["alice@example.com"]

name: send_email
